column.name: faq_id

column.comment: Product ID - null means generic, shown on any product with no FAQs of its own

column.name: category

column.name: sort_order
column.comment: Sort Order

column.comment: Created At

table.name: ahy_pdprevamp_variant_color
table.comment: Admin-set exact swatch hex color per simple product variant

column.name: product_id
column.comment: Simple Product Entity ID

column.name: hex
column.comment: Hex color value, e.g. #161616

table.name: ahy_pdprevamp_review_tags
table.comment: AI-generated highlight tags per review (Yotpo or native), cached so Gemini is only called once per review

column.name: review_id
column.comment: Yotpo review id, or native_<review_id> for Magento's own native review fallback

column.name: tags
column.comment: Comma-separated AI-generated tags - empty string means Gemini found nothing confident to tag

column.name: created_at
column.comment: Created At

table.name: ahy_pdprevamp_review_vote
table.comment: Which customer voted on which review, so a vote cannot be repeated

column.name: vote_id
column.comment: Vote ID

column.name: review_id
column.comment: Yotpo review id, or native_<review_id> for Magento's own native review fallback

column.name: customer_id
column.comment: Customer who cast the vote - voting requires being logged in

column.name: vote_type
column.comment: up|down - stored rather than a boolean so the UI can highlight the right icon after a reload

column.name: created_at
column.comment: Created At

column.name: entity_id
column.comment: Claim ID

column.name: email
column.comment: Email the code was issued to

column.name: coupon_code
column.comment: Generated single-use coupon code

column.name: customer_id
column.comment: Null when claimed as a guest - backfilled on register/login so the one-per-customer limit recognises them

column.name: product_id
column.comment: Product whose PDP the popup was shown on - recorded for reporting; the discount itself is not bound to it

column.name: is_redeemed
column.comment: 1 once the code has been used, so the grid can show claimed vs redeemed

column.name: created_at
column.comment: Claimed At

column.name: expires_at
column.comment: Mirror of the coupon's own expiry, so the grid can show it without joining salesrule_coupon

column.name: ahy_thumb_caption
column.comment: Caption shown over the PDP gallery thumbnail
